industrial_suit_storage.notes: Orange reinforced side posts, deep cabinet and separately retracting shutter. Original industrial interior, status UV variants, hatch and content sockets. Suit/helmet/items remain separate gameplay content. UV and sterilisation duration are runtime controlled.

drone_shell_dispenser.notes: Correct drone_dispenser atlas (not the incorrect fax fallback in old inventory). Low production housing and real recessed output tray. off/on/make/recharge bindings retain all original frames and timing; output shells and 3s manufacture/3min recharge handled by game.

weapon_scanner_gate.notes: Open 1.64m passage, finished arch, separate service hatch. Transparent scan plane is intentionally not a solid wall. Set scanning/alarm UV state plus visibility clip; detection is runtime.

training_bomb.notes: Small source training device with radiating fins and replaceable inactive/active/wires artwork. Gameplay timer and reset are external; no invented explosion animation.

gulag_teleporter.notes: Vertical implant-chair enclosure with actual seat, control pedestal and connected overhead frame; separate telescoping transparent canopy. Original powered/unpowered controls, maintenance hatch and Occupant socket; prisoner and teleport effects remain dynamic.

gulag_item_reclaimer.notes: Wall terminal with projecting item slot and keyboard ledge. Off/on screen binding; reclaimed items attach at output, not baked.

monkey_recycler.notes: Open recessed grinding hopper, rollers and service hatch. Source grinder_monkey decoration and input/output anchors; input monkeys/cubes are gameplay content. Roller cycle is a suggested mechanical loop.

basketball_hoop.notes: Source 32x64 standing hoop, adapted below the station 2m ceiling. Real circular rim and open low-poly net. Score is runtime text; basketball separate.

skeleton_model.notes: Actual skeletal mannequin atlas, not inherited wooden placeholder. Rounded skull, ribs, pelvis and jointed limb bones. Eyepatch/Hawaiian shirt are source starting equipment and remain independent attachments.

quartermaster_statue.notes: Golden clothed quartermaster with hat, briefcase and stepped octagonal pedestal. Palette and face/coat UVs come from qm sprite; static statue.

snowman.notes: Three rounded low-poly snow volumes, coal and projecting carrot, palette sampled from original snowman sprite. No melting behaviour baked into asset.

cloning_pod_exhibit.notes: Static retired cloning exhibit, not a functional cloning machine. Rounded translucent capsule and low radial pedestal; pod_0 original atlas.

damaged_cryo_exhibit.notes: Horizontal old sleeper exhibit, with its source permanently raised glass lid, deep mattress cavity and finished side walls. Static museum prop; no functional treatment loop.

fermenting_barrel.notes: 12-sided bulging wooden barrel with real hollow interior, two hoops and removable lid. Labels, fruit and liquid level remain independent content.

meat_spike.notes: Shared open frame for all three placements. frame/assembled clips toggle actual metal hooks. Attached animals and bloody corpse variants are content, not permanently baked sprites.

ripley_wreckage.notes: Collapsed yellow loader with splayed feet, hanging arms and open/dark cockpit. Uses current ripley-broken, not obsolete ripley-broken-old; static salvage prop.

tachyon_doppler_array.notes: Directional sensor and monitor stand beside each other on a common base, reconstructed from four directional sprites. Power/broken display variants and maintenance hatch. Explosion measurement is runtime.

ectoscopic_sniffer.notes: Small upright detector on a low base; glass sensor window keeps original working/off/measurement frames. No enlargement to a human-sized cabinet.

exploration_scanner.notes: Tilted concave 12-sided dish on equipment base, not a flat circular sprite. Original off/ready/on bindings and maintenance panel; interfered/readiness mechanics remain runtime.

fishing_portal_generator.notes: Low oval basin-shaped device with finished inner rim. Separate original destination surface supports water/lava/other source variants via UV bindings; off hides surface. Fishing content is runtime.

broadcast_camera.notes: Directional captain-caster on a connected wooden tripod. Low-poly lens projects forward; on/off lamp binds original sprites. Video feed is runtime content.

restaurant_portal.notes: Shared bar/restaurant robot gate with source blue portal and slatted closed-venue overlay as separate geometry. Venue opening toggles shutter; robot routing and access remain runtime.

television_exhibit.notes: Small vintage wooden television with side knobs, legs and antenna. Original screen/broken-screen binding; moving newsfeed is optional runtime content.
